title: Battle of Beauharnois
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Beauharnois", at revision 1370433745, opens: "The Battle of Beauharnois was fought on November 10, 1838, between Lower Canada loyalists and Patriote rebels, after 500 armed men had converged on Beauharnois, on November 3–4, overtaking the seigneurial manor." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2888123, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1838 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
